title: memmapfile
summary: Map file bytes into a MATLAB-compatible memmapfile object.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Maps file bytes into a MATLAB-compatible memmapfile object with typed Format, Offset, Repeat, Writable metadata, and Data fields.
behaviors: Supports scalar Format type names such as uint8, uint16, uint32, single, and double.
Supports MATLAB-style Format cells such as {type, shape, field}; named formats return Data as a struct field.
Offset and Repeat are honored for typed reads. Offset beyond end of file is rejected.
The current implementation materializes mapped data into host memory; Writable is recorded but write-through mapping is not implemented yet.
